environment: word-initially before a consonant, before k and ŋ and in careful speech
notes: The four pronunciations of d (pp. 7-9). [θ] 'before k and ng and in careful pronunciation' (p. 8).
'Between vowels, k is pronounced with the voiced allophone [g]': olekiis [olagiys] (p. 9).
'Before t, d, s, and r, ng is pronounced as a dental nasal' (p. 12); [ŋ] elsewhere (p. 13).
'The consonant r is called a tapped r because it is made with a quick tapping movement of the tongue tip against the alveolar ridge' (p. 15).
'The sequence rr differs from r in that it is pronounced as a trilled r rather than a tapped r' (p. 15).
